channel.title: Klaviyo - What's New
channel.description: Latest Klaviyo product updates and releases (unofficial feed).

item.title: Composer - Segment Generation
item.description:
Composer - Segment Generation — Build segments faster with natural language prompts — describe your target audience in plain English and preview the draft segment before saving.
(Published 2026-07-27)

item.title: A/B testing with personalized send time
item.description:
A/B testing with personalized send time — Use content A/B testing and personalized send time together in the same campaign to test different message content while still delivering at each recipient's optimal time.
(Published 2026-07-27)

item.title: Composer - AI Image Controls
item.description:
Composer - AI Image Controls — Control how Composer uses AI with your images — toggle AI-generated images on or off and choose whether Composer can edit your existing brand assets.
(Published 2026-07-21)

item.title: A/B Testing in WhatsApp Flow
item.description:
A/B Testing in WhatsApp Flow — Find your highest-performing WhatsApp message faster — add A/B tests directly inside any flow to compare content and auto-select the winner.
(Published 2026-07-21)

item.title: Composer - Push Campaigns
item.description:
Composer - Push Campaigns — Create push notification content faster — use Composer to generate messages for your mobile push campaigns.
(Published 2026-07-20)

item.title: Minute-level gradual sending for campaigns
item.description:
Minute-level gradual sending for campaigns — Protect your site from traffic spikes and manage deliverability with finer control — schedule campaign batches as small as 1% per minute instead of hourly intervals.
(Published 2026-07-16)

item.title: API release 2026-07-15
item.description:
API release 2026-07-15 — Build deeper integrations and automate more of your Klaviyo setup — use new endpoints for custom objects, multi-channel conversations, Customer Agent, and more.
(Published 2026-07-15)

item.title: Social content in marketing messages
item.description:
Social content in marketing messages — Embed your best Instagram posts directly into emails, SMS messages, and sign-up forms without leaving Klaviyo.
(Published 2026-07-14)

item.title: Social Insights Agent - Proactive cards and Composer chat
item.description:
Social Insights Agent - Proactive cards and Composer chat — Get AI-powered analysis of your Instagram UGC—top creators, emerging themes, and post performance—delivered as proactive insight cards or through Composer chat.
(Published 2026-07-10)

item.title: Composer - Campaign brief
item.description:
Composer - Campaign brief — Get faster, more accurate campaign drafts — use Campaign Brief to attach templates, images, coupons, and products before Composer generates your content.
(Published 2026-07-08)

item.title: Manage Email Open Tracking
item.description:
Manage Email Open Tracking — Meet data privacy requirements for email open tracking — set tracking consent at the account level or for specific recipients.
(Published 2026-07-08)

item.title: Composer - Subject line & preview text intelligence
item.description:
Composer - Subject line & preview text intelligence — Get subject lines and preview text informed by what's worked for your brand — use Composer to generate email copy based on your historic message performance.
(Published 2026-07-07)

item.title: Composer - Universal content support
item.description:
Composer - Universal content support — Keep your brand elements consistent across AI-generated emails — reference universal content blocks, headers, and footers directly in your Composer prompts.
(Published 2026-07-07)

item.title: Composer - Addressing image sizing inconsistencies
item.description:
Composer - Addressing image sizing inconsistencies — Get consistent image sizing across content blocks in AI-generated emails — use Composer to create polished grid layouts without manual resizing.
(Published 2026-07-07)

item.title: Composer
item.description:
Composer — Get an always-on marketing expert that analyzes your performance, audits your flows and campaigns, and drafts messages grounded in your real account data — use Composer to surface your next best move and act on it in minutes.
(Published 2026-06-30)

item.title: Custom CSS for Klaviyo Sign-up Forms
item.description:
Custom CSS for Klaviyo Sign-up Forms — Match your sign-up forms exactly to your brand's look and feel — use custom CSS to control line height, letter spacing, element spacing, and right-to-left text directly in the forms editor.
(Published 2026-06-29)

item.title: Multi-Email Profiles
item.description:
Multi-Email Profiles — Get a single, unified view of each customer across up to five email addresses — Create cleaner profiles with independent consent tracking and smarter send routing.
(Published 2026-06-29)

item.title: Embedded personalized content blocks
item.description:
Embedded personalized content blocks — Show personalized messaging, promotions, and CTAs directly on your Shopify storefront — create content blocks in Customer Hub, then drop them into your theme without touching code.
(Published 2026-06-29)

item.title: Customer Agent, Public APIs
item.description:
Customer Agent, Public APIs — Automate agent setup, pull conversation data, and embed Customer Agent into custom surfaces — use the new public REST API to configure, monitor, and run your agent programmatically.
(Published 2026-06-26)

item.title: Customer Agent, Profile Context Tools
item.description:
Customer Agent, Profile Context Tools — Ground agent responses in real shopper data — use built-in profile tools to read order history, segment membership, and predictive analytics during any conversation.
(Published 2026-06-26)

item.title: Instagram 1-to-Many
item.description:
Instagram 1-to-Many — Run multiple regional Klaviyo accounts from a single global Instagram — connect one Instagram to all your Klaviyo accounts with Social Marketing.
(Published 2026-06-26)

item.title: Customer Agent, Profile Enrichment
item.description:
Customer Agent, Profile Enrichment — Turn support conversations into first-party data — use Profile Enrichment to capture shopper preferences and intent as profile properties in real time.
(Published 2026-06-24)

item.title: Figma Plugin
item.description:
Figma Plugin — Move design assets to your media library without leaving Figma — export single or multiple items, name them on the fly, and switch between connected Klaviyo accounts.
(Published 2026-06-24)

item.title: Cart in Customer Hub
item.description:
Cart in Customer Hub — Give shoppers a seamless mini-cart experience with personalized product recommendations — enable Cart in Customer Hub to surface upsells and increase average order value.
(Published 2026-06-23)

item.title: Flow Analytics Dashboard
item.description:
Flow Analytics Dashboard — Compare flow performance across channels and time periods — use the new Flow Analytics dashboard to track revenue, conversions, and deliveries with period-over-period insights.
(Published 2026-06-22)

item.title: Event Property Filters for In-App Form Triggers
item.description:
Event Property Filters for In-App Form Triggers — Show in-app forms only when event properties match specific values — add an event property filter to your display triggers for more precise, contextual targeting.
(Published 2026-06-18)

item.title: Onsite Tracking for Olo via Google Tag Manager
item.description:
Onsite Tracking for Olo via Google Tag Manager — Track browse, cart, and checkout behavior from Olo Serve ordering sites — add the Klaviyo tag in Google Tag Manager to capture guest activity and trigger abandonment flows.
(Published 2026-06-18)

item.title: Klaviyo extension for Shopify Sidekick
item.description:
Klaviyo extension for Shopify Sidekick — Get answers about your Klaviyo marketing performance without leaving Shopify — ask Sidekick about campaigns, flows, and segments, then deep-link back to Klaviyo to act.
(Published 2026-06-17)

item.title: Smarter Sync for OTA Guests + Real-Time Cloudbeds Updates
item.description:
Smarter Sync for OTA Guests + Real-Time Cloudbeds Updates — Reach guests who book through OTAs and keep reservation data accurate as changes happen — use real-time reservation sync to trigger check-in, mid-stay, and post-stay flows on the right dates.
(Published 2026-06-16)

item.title: Product Feeds in Text: Dynamic Product Recommendations in SMS
item.description:
Product Feeds in Text: Dynamic Product Recommendations in SMS — Send personalized product recommendations via SMS using real-time catalog and customer data.
(Published 2026-06-15)

item.title: Magento 2 WhatsApp consent collection
item.description:
Magento 2 WhatsApp consent collection — Capture WhatsApp opt-ins at checkout when shoppers are most likely to subscribe — enable WhatsApp consent alongside SMS in your Magento 2 integration settings. [Learn more](https://help.klaviyo.com/hc/en-us/articles/360058698511)
(Published 2026-06-12)

item.title: WhatsApp Sending Numbers from Klaviyo
item.description:
WhatsApp Sending Numbers from Klaviyo — Skip the hassle of buying a WhatsApp number from a third-party provider — get one directly in Klaviyo and start sending faster.
(Published 2026-06-09)

item.title: Push Action Buttons
item.description:
Push Action Buttons — Shorten the path from notification to conversion — add up to 3 action buttons that open your app or deep link to a specific screen.
(Published 2026-06-05)

item.title: API Key Disablement
item.description:
API Key Disablement — Respond to suspected credential exposure in seconds without deleting your keys — disable and re-enable API keys directly from settings.
(Published 2026-06-05)

item.title: Customer Agent Multilingual
item.description:
Customer Agent Multilingual — Serve any shopper in their native language without duplicating your agent setup — configure once and let Customer Agent respond automatically in whatever language customers write.
(Published 2026-06-04)

item.title: Simplified Language Management
item.description:
Simplified Language Management — Update multiple language settings at once instead of one by one — add or remove locales in bulk from the Smart Translations modal.
(Published 2026-06-04)

item.title: WhatsApp consent on WooCommerce checkout
item.description:
WhatsApp consent on WooCommerce checkout — Capture WhatsApp subscribers at checkout when purchase intent is highest — enable WhatsApp consent collection in your WooCommerce integration settings.
(Published 2026-06-02)

item.title: Reporting Dashboards for Hospitality
item.description:
Reporting Dashboards for Hospitality — See guest, reservation, and loyalty metrics in one place without building custom reports — view pre-built dashboards that appear automatically based on your restaurant or hotel integrations.
(Published 2026-06-02)

item.title: Smart Translations - Import Glossary settings
item.description:
Smart Translations - Import Glossary settings — Manage translation terminology at scale — import hundreds of glossary terms via CSV instead of adding them one by one.
(Published 2026-06-01)

item.title: DND create and update email template tools in MCP
item.description:
DND create and update email template tools in MCP — Design email templates with AI tools like Claude or ChatGPT and land on clean, editable drag-and-drop templates in Klaviyo — use the new MCP Server tools to skip the HTML handoff.
(Published 2026-05-29)

item.title: Transactional and Service Branded Sending Domains
item.description:
Transactional and Service Branded Sending Domains — Protect your transactional and service email reputation from marketing volume fluctuations — set up separate branded sending domains for each send type.
(Published 2026-05-28)

item.title: Self-Serve Dedicated Click Tracking
item.description:
Self-Serve Dedicated Click Tracking — Strengthen brand trust and email deliverability with cleaner link URLs — set up a dedicated click-tracking domain directly in account settings.
(Published 2026-05-28)

item.title: Mobile Channel Automation Improvements
item.description:
Mobile Channel Automation Improvements — Collect richer zero-party data and merge phone-only profiles with existing email profiles — use new question types, longer messages, rich formatting, and video support in WhatsApp and SMS automations.
(Published 2026-05-28)

item.title: Punchh Offer Management + Reward Object
item.description:
Punchh Offer Management + Reward Object — Drive loyalty engagement with real-time reward data and automated offer distribution — sync Punchh rewards to profiles and trigger countdown flows based on expiration dates.
(Published 2026-05-20)

item.title: Mobile Push A/B testing in Flows (GA)
item.description:
Mobile Push A/B testing in Flows (GA) — Optimize push notification performance — create A/B tests in Flow Builder to compare titles, body copy, and push behavior, then pick winners based on engagement rate.
(Published 2026-05-15)

item.title: URL Targeted Content Blocks
item.description:
URL Targeted Content Blocks — Show the right onsite content on the right pages — Target Customer Hub content blocks by URL rules to create more relevant shopping experiences and reduce misplaced messaging.
(Published 2026-05-08)

item.title: Prepared Order Event - Toast Integration
item.description:
Prepared Order Event - Toast Integration — Send timely food-ready updates that drive more orders — Use Toast’s new Prepared Order event to notify guests when orders are ready and promote relevant add-ons.
(Published 2026-05-08)

item.title: Personalized Content Blocks with Profile Picker
item.description:
Personalized Content Blocks with Profile Picker — Personalize onsite content more easily — Use the profile picker in Customer Hub to quickly add profile properties to content blocks without manual setup.
(Published 2026-05-08)

item.title: Integrations Schema for Customer Hub
item.description:
Integrations Schema for Customer Hub — Expand Customer Hub integrations without custom builds — Surface approved partner events for WISMO, returns, loyalty, and subscriptions so more onsite experiences work with the tools already in your stack.
(Published 2026-05-08)

item.title: Multi-Message Onsite Banners
item.description:
Multi-Message Onsite Banners — Create more engaging onsite experiences — Show multi-scroll personalized banners with deeper targeting to surface more relevant messages to each shopper.
(Published 2026-05-08)

item.title: In-App Forms Mobile SDK Hooks
item.description:
In-App Forms Mobile SDK Hooks — Build more flexible in-app experiences for developers — Use native SDK hooks to track when forms are shown, dismissed, or clicked and trigger custom app actions.
(Published 2026-05-07)

item.title: Flyout Forms In-App
item.description:
Flyout Forms In-App — Create less disruptive in-app experiences — Use flyout forms to slide messages into mobile apps while keeping the rest of the screen usable.
(Published 2026-05-07)

item.title: iOS Background Processing / Content Available
item.description:
iOS Background Processing / Content Available — Power more custom iOS app experiences — Enable background processing for standard push notifications so your app can refresh data or run tasks when a notification is delivered.
(Published 2026-05-06)

item.title: Automatic UTM Parameters For Deep Links
item.description:
Automatic UTM Parameters For Deep Links — Track push performance more reliably — Automatically add UTM parameters to deep links in new push campaigns and flow messages to reduce errors and improve reporting.
(Published 2026-05-06)

item.title: Shopify Coupon Combinations
item.description:
Shopify Coupon Combinations — Build more personalized Shopify promotions — Allow Klaviyo-generated coupons to stack with other discounts at checkout for more flexible, tailored offers.
(Published 2026-05-06)

item.title: Geofencing Enhancements
item.description:
Geofencing Enhancements — Scale location-based messaging with less setup — Import, pause, and manage up to 5,000 geofences to speed onboarding and support more retail locations.
(Published 2026-05-01)

item.title: Data Warehouse Import: Record-level Error Reporting
item.description:
Data Warehouse Import: Record-level Error Reporting — Troubleshoot warehouse sync errors faster — Download row-level error reports and view clearer run statuses to fix data quality issues without extra back-and-forth.
(Published 2026-05-01)

item.title: Data Warehouse Import: Connection and Command-level Error Visibility
item.description:
Data Warehouse Import: Connection and Command-level Error Visibility — Diagnose warehouse sync issues without support — View in-product logs and run-level errors to identify permissions, schema, firewall, timeout, or data quality problems faster.
(Published 2026-05-01)

item.title: Channel Affinity for WhatsApp
item.description:
Channel Affinity for WhatsApp — Reach every shopper on their preferred channel — Include WhatsApp in Channel Affinity to automatically optimize message delivery across email, SMS, push, and WhatsApp.
(Published 2026-04-30)

item.title: Category Analysis Dashboard
item.description:
Category Analysis Dashboard — Make smarter merchandising decisions faster — Analyze category-level revenue, orders, and engagement trends to spot opportunities without manually aggregating product data.
(Published 2026-04-29)
